lines.en: My feet are caked in mud.
I hop between the mangrove roots.

lines.zh: 浅水被我踩出一串响声
lines.en: Shallow water splashes under my feet.
Two hops, then a pause.
Mud holds no prints of mine.
I slip into the gap between roots.

lines.zh: 我踩着倒下的树干过去
lines.en: I cross on a fallen trunk.
The swamp water is warm.
One hop flicks mud off my fur.
I follow the waterline for a path.
My ears swivel in the shade.

lines.zh: 我从一片泥地跳到另一片
lines.en: I hop from one mudflat to the next.
I sit, my feet still wet.
I am listening underwater.
Dry mud feels wrong on me.
My nose never stops twitching.

lines.zh: 我盯着水面上一片叶子
lines.en: I watch a leaf on the water.
Mangrove roots hang before my face.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，藏进泥色里
lines.en: I hold still, blending into the mud.
The swamp is quiet today.
I shake water off my ears.
Insects call, and I ignore them.
I tuck myself into a ball.

lines.zh: 泥里凉快，我多待一会儿
lines.en: The mud is cool; I will stay a while.
I count the vines on the roots.

lines.zh: 风吹过沼泽，水面皱起来
lines.en: Wind ripples the swamp water.
I want to hop, but I am too lazy.

lines.zh: 我把湿耳朵在肩上蹭干
lines.en: I dry my wet ears against my shoulder.
Nobody comes to bother me here.
I know this swamp's smell well.
You stepped into my mud.
I look up, ears perked.
Is your boot muddy too?

lines.zh: 我把脑袋歪向一边看你
lines.en: I cock my head at you.
I am not afraid, just unwilling to move.
The water where you stand is deep.
My nose works; I have your scent.

lines.zh: 你要抓我，我跑得比你快
lines.en: Try to catch me and I am faster.
My path runs behind the mangroves.
You are blocking my way out.
Only my eyes show above the mud.
Kneel down and I will stop running.
Pain makes me hop.

lines.zh: 这一下疼得我缩成一团
lines.en: The blow makes me curl into a ball.
I shrink down into the mud.

lines.zh: 这一下压在我的脊梁上
lines.en: That landed on my spine.
I shake myself.
My ears lie flat against my head.
I squeeze into a root gap.
I give a sharp cry.
These legs can still run.

lines.zh: 泥把我盖住了，疼也轻些
lines.en: Mud covers me, and it hurts less.
What is that smell?
I smell something sweet.
Put it on the ground and let me look.
My ears moved first.
I hop a little closer.

lines.zh: 泥地里的东西我都能吃
lines.en: Anything in the mud, I can eat.
I grab it and back off.
Keep that hand of yours still.
Not worth a hop.
I chew a little faster than usual.
You bumped my backside.
I am small, and you still hit me.
I hop aside and land in the mud.
Do not step, I am right here.
The bump sends me rolling.
You caught my ear.
Mud splashes your leg.
I shake and spatter you.
We each back off a step.
Your feet are far too big.
We rub noses.
I hop a circle around her.
These roots can hide us both.
We crouch side by side.
Her ears are longer than mine.
We hop the same path.
The burrow is already dug.
We take turns watching outside.
When she moves, I follow.
The swamp is big enough for us.
What falls in the mud is mine.
I grab it and shake it.
This thing is covered in mud.
I try a bite.
Too hard, so I push it.
It is bigger than my head.
I hide it in a root crevice.
Whoever dropped it, it is mine now.
I roll it into a gap between roots.
This will last me a while.
You are at my door.
I stare at you without blinking.
My ears have gone back.
You are standing on my burrow.
My hind legs are loaded.

lines.zh: 这种脚步我一下就听出来
lines.en: I can pick out that footstep at once.
Back off, I count to three.
This mudflat is mine.
Small as I am, I bite.
I am not moving aside.
I watch the foot you are about to set down.
I wait for you to step wrong.
I circle through the roots.
You cannot catch me.

lines.zh: 我在量这段泥地的距离
lines.en: I am measuring this stretch of mud.
My hind legs stay loaded.
I wait for you to take one more step.
The swamp hides me.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵听着你的呼吸
lines.en: My ears track your breathing.
I have not moved; I am still waiting.
I bit you.
My hind legs kick your hand.
Light, but real.
I bite and bolt back into the mud.
My front teeth are sharp.
You pulled back, good.
I kick you once and bolt.
That bite was a warning.
I land back in the mud and vanish.
Do not come digging at my burrow again.

lines.zh: 我从红树的根后跳出来
lines.en: I hop out from behind the mangrove roots.
The mudflat has a new pair of prints.
The mud here is just right.
I hopped here along the water.
I know this swamp smell.
First I found a dry patch.
My ears come out first.
The roots here are dense enough.
I wipe the mud off my feet.
The water shows my reflection.
I crouch and scout first.
Quiet here, so I am staying.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的毛，一股焦味
lines.en: Fire singes my fur and it reeks.
I slip off a root.

lines.zh: 水没到我的鼻子，我乱蹬
lines.en: Water covers my nose and I kick wildly.
The blast throws me out of the mud.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在我旁边的树根上
lines.en: An arrow lodges in the root beside me.
Magic leaves me numb.
No tender leaves left to find.

lines.zh: 雷打中红树，我吓得乱跳
lines.en: Lightning hits the mangrove and I bolt.
The mud beneath me is gone.
